_schema_comment: Claim/lock log for concurrent agents. Append-only by any agent before writing files. Entry kinds: write (a claim) | release (release of a prior claim) | renew (extend an expiring claim). Fields per claim: timestamp, agent_id, zone, paths, intent, expires_at. Fields per release: timestamp, agent_id, intent, claim_timestamp. See agent/collision_protocol.md §1 for the schema and §2 for the protocol.
